card.name: Just before an abbreviation in brackets
card.fires_on: The last piece of a term right before its short form or bracketed value is given, such as 'aminotransferase' before [ALT] or 'creatinine clearance' before [CrCl]. Also fires at a unit or closing bracket before a bracketed conversion.

modes.label: Enzyme names before abbreviation
modes.description: The end of 'aminotransferase' just before the bracketed ALT or AST.

modes.label: Units before bracketed conversion
modes.description: A unit or closing bracket right before a bracketed second value.

modes.label: Term before bracketed short form
modes.description: A full term that is about to be followed by its bracketed abbreviation.

card.writes: It seems to promote backslash and math-style symbols and suppress opening parentheses, so it gives a weak push away from bracket openers.
card.plain: It lights up on the last part of a term just before a bracketed abbreviation or conversion appears.
